name: prototype
description: Inspect prototype starts and a layer's interactions, create or rename a flow, and connect a layer to a different frame on click. Uses an explicit documentId and the session's selected page. Existing advanced click behavior is protected.

action.description: inspect returns start frames and, with sourceId, the specified layer's interactions. set_flow and remove_flow require frameId. set_navigation requires sourceId and destinationId. remove_navigation requires sourceId.
